Moses.title: Moses
Moses.question: Will a rescued people learn to trust the God who leads them through uncertainty?

chapters.title: The Child in the River
chapters.game: Guide the basket through reeds while Miriam keeps watch.

chapters.title: The Burning Bush
chapters.game: Herd sheep, approach the fire, and answer the call.

chapters.title: Before the Throne
chapters.game: Match signs and warnings to each audience.

chapters.title: Passover Night
chapters.game: Prepare the meal and mark the doorway before departure.

chapters.title: Through the Sea
chapters.game: Keep the people moving along the opened path.

chapters.title: Bread in the Wilderness
chapters.game: Gather only enough manna for the day.

chapters.title: Sinai
chapters.game: Arrange the camp and carry the covenant words.

chapters.title: The Golden Calf
chapters.game: Confront the idol and intercede for the people.

chapters.title: Mount Nebo
chapters.game: Appoint Joshua and identify the land from afar.
